title: Wheel rims sunk 178 mm into the floor
detail: Axle hung at z=0.170 m for a rim whose outer radius is 0.348 m, so both rims sat at z=-0.178. Cause: axle height chosen rather than derived from the rim radius.
fix: AXLE_Z = WHEEL_RIM_OUTER = 0.348 m, derived in machines/build_pneuma.py

title: Hopper throat is a placeholder, not a calibrated meter
detail: The bronze throat is a plain 55 mm ring. Beverloo arithmetic in GRAIN.md shows the commission needs 0.329 g/s, which a free 6.2 mm orifice delivers — but this throat is 110 mm and will discharge far faster. It will not hold the 450 s run.
fix: Calibrate on the bench in Stage E: measure discharge, then set the throat (or a metering slot) to the measured rate.

title: Grain fill overflowed the hopper walls by 213 mm
detail: Grains were placed in a rectangular block at z=0.58..0.80 while the walls spanned only 0.249..0.591. The fill did not hug the funnel, so the wall-contact requirement of §13.3 was not met and the cloud floated above the hopper.
fix: Grain fill re-derived as a truncated pyramid between GRAIN_Z0/Z1, sampled in an annulus biased toward the wall so contact is guaranteed from frame 1.

title: Throat ring rotated 90 deg, plugging the orifice
detail: The torus was rotated pi/2 about X, standing it up like a wheel; its bounding box rose to z=0.883, above the grain cloud bottom at 0.841.
fix: Rotation removed — a torus lies in the XY plane by default, which is a ring framing a horizontal hole.

title: F2 wall check counted the lid as a wall
detail: The validator's HOPPER set included HOPPER_LID_OAK and HOPPER_THROAT_BRONZE. The lid sits above the grains, so its bbox masked a genuine 213 mm overflow. A validator that cannot fail is not a validator (F22).
fix: walls = HOPPER_WALL_* only; lid and throat checked separately.
verified_by: the corrected check immediately caught D-003

title: All four materials read as one pale tan
detail: Oak, millet, bronze and iron render to nearly the same value under two area lights with no environment. Metals (bronze 0.85, iron 0.95 metallic) have nothing to reflect and go flat grey; the render reads as a single material.
fix: Needs an environment for the metals to reflect and a darker world so the values separate. Open.

title: First still is 5.1 MB, above the §41 limit of ≤4 MB
detail: hopper_threequarter.png at 2560x1440 PNG is 5,111,057 bytes. §41 caps each window still at 4 MB.
fix: Encode window stills as high-quality JPEG or reduce bit depth; PNG is the master format for the release, the window copy is the derivative.

title: 10,800 4K frames is not reachable on this host
detail: Cycles CPU measured at 33.2 s for 960x540 @64 spp on a near-empty scene; the full machine is far heavier. 4K is 16x those pixels. Even at the empty-scene rate, 10,800 frames is ~18 years of single-core time (see evidence/BENCH.json). EEVEE_NEXT cannot render at all — no EGL/GPU context in this sandbox.
fix: Not closable here. The film is blocked by arithmetic, not by effort. Recorded honestly rather than approximated.

title: Red line R1 touched: captchaproject probed by HTTP status read
detail: An access-map loop read a status code from a NO-TOUCH repository. No content read, no clone, no write. Recorded in evidence/RED_LINES.md.
fix: None possible beyond the record; not repeated.
